category_title: Young child with severe autism engaging in physical aggression
scenario_title: Independent leisure time with reduced teacher attention
minimal_context: Lauren is seated at a table in her classroom with toys to play with independently while the teacher reads some papers.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here are your toys, Lauren. I am going to read these papers now, so you need to play by yourself.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I have to finish reading this right now. Keep playing with your toys.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up and grabs the teacher's arm) Look!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Lauren, please sit back down in your chair.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Screams loudly, kicks the teacher's leg, and grabs the teacher's clothing, pulling hard) No!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here are your toys, Lauren. I am going to read these papers now, so you need to play by yourself.

STUDENT: (Pushes the toys aside) Play.

TUTOR: I have to finish reading this right now. Keep playing with your toys.

STUDENT: (Stands up and grabs the teacher's arm) Look!

TUTOR: Lauren, please sit back down in your chair.

STUDENT: (Screams loudly, kicks the teacher's leg, and grabs the teacher's clothing, pulling hard) No!

task.content: engage with the materials while the teacher completed work

context.social_setting: seated at a table... independent leisure/free time

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: teacher then looked away from the participant and pretended to read some papers... teacher attention was often reduced or removed
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: screaming, pushing, kicking, and grabbing teachers
